name: salmon
notes: Salmon, about 75 cm: steel-blue and silver fresh from the sea, going dark bronze and coppery red as it runs up the rivers in autumn to spawn. Holds in small groups in the deep pools and leaps often.

morphs.name: bright
morphs.notes: Fresh run from the sea: steel-blue back, bright silver sides.

morphs.name: run
morphs.notes: Spawning colour, deep in the run: dark olive-bronze back, coppery red flanks.
